about: Milestone N3c of ADR 0012, subflows by path, results across scopes, stop propagation and failure modules in bodies: the catalogue cases of CF-16 to CF-18, CF-20, CF-29 and CF-V1 to CF-V5, recorded on the CE oracle by the fixtures below, which N3c wrote and whose runs its exit gate runs on windmill-lite. CF-19's cases are E3a's and E3d's (flows/cf/cf-19), and CF-V2/a is also recorded by flows/control-flow/cf-13 run c. Each case is recorded by a run or deferred with a reason: CF-V4/b and CF-V5/b need an inline or raw-preview submission, which windmill-lite never runs (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6); CF-17/b to CF-17/i are recorded by milestone N5's fixture flows/control-flow/subflow-retry, outside this batch; CF-16/e, CF-16/f and CF-17/j, which the reference added in its revision SC4, were requested from batch E3f, which recorded them. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: source-derived in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a container's own settings on handled failures and forwarded stops, item 1). A sequential loop whose iteration's copy of the failure module handled the failure is still a Failure, which the loop's continue_on_error tolerates at any position: the flow succeeds with ["H"], and the flow's own handler runs only for a later step that fails. A parallel container's handled failure is not tolerated (CF-7/f, e3d.json). N3c runs a failure module in loop bodies. Recorded by batch E3f (conformance/flows/control-flow/cf-16-tolerated, runs e_alone, e_next, e_next_fails; internal/oracle/testdata/batches/e3f.json).

source-derived in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a container's own settings on handled failures and forwarded stops, item 2). A retry on the loop runs the handled iteration again, each child flow running its copy of the handler, and the flow then fails with ["H"] with no handler job at the root. NI runs a retry on a container. Recorded by batch E3f (conformance/flows/control-flow/cf-16-tolerated, run f_retry; internal/oracle/testdata/batches/e3f.json).
